sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('df341f63-0fef-4411-a89b-6df6b9e792be', '377c3ecb-fdec-dde4-e063-6294a90a29bd') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
